title: "Materials & Interfaces"
sidebar: get-started

Select a material record for each physical body and an interface preset only
when your model needs one. Keep the selected IDs with your simulation inputs.

## Material records

`get_material_records()`, `get_material_alias_records()`, and
`get_interface_preset_records()` return detached records from OrcaPen's
[public material database](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/aee7f8b848895f2d107f6b086310e866e8381f73/orcapen_sc_pdk/materials.json).

Records identify material kind, superconducting status, numeric properties,
and explicit AEDT library names. An alias selects an existing identity;
it does not create a new physical material.

Use the [generated material API](../reference/index.qmd#materials) for signatures
and the [Layers & Stack guide](layers.qmd) for assigning material and height together.

## Surface interfaces

| Interface | Physical boundary |
| --- | --- |
| MA | Metal–air |
| MS | Metal–substrate |
| SA | Substrate–air |

The database includes Woods2019 Si and LiteratureCentral interface presets.
Their thickness, permittivity, loss tangent, and source are model assumptions
you select, not automatic process defaults or measured properties for every device.

For participation calculations, preserve the preset and field-side choice with
the returned result. [Participation & Surface Loss](../simulation/requirements/epr-loss.qmd)
links the concrete tutorials. [Research](../papers/surface-loss-participation.md)
collects the source literature.
